look: Wailing Banshee, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Gloomshades family: translucent banshee with streaming hair, mouth open in a scream. Family anatomy: ghostly translucent shades, banshees and wraiths trailing shadow smoke. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are violet shade crystal. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, clear shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
